animals shown in profile walking to the side

justification: Both depict the same distinctive scheme: a horizontal relief frieze of profile robed attendants in procession accompanied by profile quadrupeds, bounded above and below by a band of rosettes, on a stepped facade — A shows this at small scale within a framed painted view while B is a close-up of a comparable frieze. The main difference in depicted content is that B foregrounds a specific two-humped camel led by an attendant, while A's frieze includes lion-attacking-bull groups and a wide architectural setting with columns and sky.
